create_Bunch_class: create a dot-accessible dictionary object by instantiating the Bunch class with a dict argument
convert_to_bunch: convert nested dicts and lists into dot-accessible Bunch objects using the to_bunch function
merge_json_dicts: merge two JSON-compatible dicts or lists together using the merge_json function
review_Bunch_class: review the Bunch class that extends dict to allow attribute-style access to dictionary keys
test_merge_json: test the merge_json function to verify it correctly merges nested dicts and extends lists
